translations.web: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
translations.bsb: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.
translations.kjv: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
translations.asv: even as thou gavest him authority over all flesh, that to all whom thou hast given him, he should give eternal life.
